faq_heading: Homes near Sacred Heart: your questions answered

faq.q: Does living near Sacred Heart get a child a place?
faq.a: No. Sacred Heart is an independent school and sets its own admission, so distance does not decide it. Ask the school how applications and wait lists work.

faq.q: How does the Sacred Heart home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names Sacred Heart, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: How much do homes near Sacred Heart sell for?
faq.a: Within 2 km of the school, 123 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,325,500, townhomes $850,000, condos $560,000. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near Sacred Heart?
faq.a: Within 2 km of Sacred Heart the median was 21 days on the market, closing at 97.0% of the list price, with 7% of sales above the list price for the 123 homes within 2 km.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Sacred Heart?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Ladner Elementary (1.0 km north-west), Delta Secondary (1.3 km north) and Delta Christian School (1.6 km north).

Sacred Heart is an independent school in Delta. It teaches grades K to 7.
Use the search below to see homes for sale that name Sacred Heart in the listing, then check the sold prices within 2 km of the school.
How the Sacred Heart search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Sacred Heart, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 2 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.

Between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, 123 homes sold within 2 km of Sacred Heart: 46 houses, 29 townhomes and 43 condos. The largest group was houses, at a median of $1,325,500.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Sacred Heart

7 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Sacred Heart in a straight line (5 elementary, 2 secondary; 1 independent). The closest is Ladner Elementary, 1.0 km away, and the farthest on this list is Hawthorne Elementary, 2.4 km away. By type, the nearest secondary school is Delta Secondary (1.3 km); the nearest independent school is Delta Christian School (1.6 km). Other elementary schools close by: Ladner Elementary (1.0 km north-west), Delta Christian School (1.6 km north), Port Guichon Elementary (1.8 km north-west), Holly Elementary (2.3 km north-east), Hawthorne Elementary (2.4 km north). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is Ladner Elementary, 1.0 km north-west of Sacred Heart.

blocks.text: Before you offer on a home near Sacred Heart

items.t: Ask Sacred Heart how admission works. A short distance does not give a child a place.
View the home on a school day. Drop-off and pick-up near Sacred Heart change the street more than a weekend viewing shows.
Compare price with similar homes farther from the school. The median house within 2 km of Sacred Heart was $1,325,500, so check whether size and age explain a gap before you pay for the location.
Look at Ladner Elementary, the nearest other elementary school, 1.0 km north-west of Sacred Heart. Compare the two when you check which school serves the address.
